styleLock.backgroundSystem: one flat solid-colour panel per screen: #F2691C field with a #1E2C78 headline band for claim screens, seamless #FFFFFF sweep for packshots and macro, real woodgrain laminate #A8A5A1 only on in-context placement scenes
styleLock.lightingSystem: even soft studio light, defined front-left key with bounce fill, gentle falloff, controlled speculars along moulded edges, believable soft contact shadows, 5500K on the laminate scene
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte woodgrain laminate #A8A5A1 floor and painted #EDE7E0 baseboard for scenes, seamless #FFFFFF sweep for packshots, flat printed panels elsewhere
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif with heavy condensed display headlines, one headline per screen, labels as single short lines, all copy carried by placeholders
styleLock.iconSystem: thin single-weight line icons in #FFFFFF on the flat panel, no fills, no pictorial illustration
styleLock.presentationRules: product keeps one consistent scale family and angle logic; the transparent unit is always shown closed and seated with a contact shadow; label faces stay blank unprinted panels
noDrift: no gradient or textured backgrounds inside flat panels
no photographic insects or pests in any screen
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent bold flat-panel household pest-control ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of a signal panel #F2691C, a deep indigo headline band #1E2C78, a seamless field #FFFFFF and a woodgrain laminate surface #A8A5A1; neutral tone; modern geometric sans-serif with heavy condensed display headlines; one flat solid-colour background per screen with no gradients and no photographic texture except the laminate floor; even soft studio lighting with a defined front-left key, gentle falloff, controlled speculars on moulded edges and believable soft contact shadows; thin single-weight line icons only, drawn in #FFFFFF; infographic components limited to flat colour bands, numbered discs, dot-leader rows, one dotted route line and one pill-shaped button; stable product scale and angle family across the set; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no gradient backgrounds, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

provenance.notes: 逐图事实：01 正面包装盒含字标、靶心虫体插画与件数角标；02 双栏对比，左为手持气雾罐加禁止环、右为单只饵盒，上方大写主张与底部来源脚注；03 橙色标题带加踢脚线暗缝实景，缝隙口有单只虫体；04 橙底斜置饵盒配左上加粗主张；05 灰木纹地板靠门坎实景，双段主张文案；06 三款同系列包装盒并列，上方排名主张与销量脚注；07 三枚圆形编号步骤，含虫群路径与底部死虫画面；08 橙底六枚细线图标（踢脚线、墙角、窗台、台面、家电后、入口）；09 三格竖拼不同材质地面摆放；10 橙带加白底多行等距件数阵列；11 橙底成分含量点线表；12、13 白底单只饵盒斜置，12 带三只虫体；14 白色踢脚线与不锈钢家电边角实景高俯摆放；15 背面使用步骤多条、厨房与房屋两幅区域示意及存储处置条文。品类判定依据：产品为放置于室内地面的密封液体饵盒，无电加热、无电机、非喷雾剂型，属家居日用/驱虫，与源类目提示一致；虽具农药属性但不属医药保健的家庭常备或医疗器械，故不改判。已剥离内容：源品牌字标与系列名、包装版面插画、靶心与全部虫体画面（活虫与死虫一律不入成品模版，改以每镜负面清单禁现，并把机制说明重写为编号圆盘加虚线路径的可拍结构）、杀灭率与倍数比较、件数角标、排名与销量主张、成分百分比、更换周期与时长表述（全部改为空参数行、空数值位、空白勾选位或以 {callout_n}、{selling_point_n} 占位）、原平台店铺字样与评论星条类社会证明、原文案原句与来源脚注。
